01 — The Album

Good morning,
Mr. West

Released September 11, 2007, Graduation closed the trilogy that began with The College Dropout — and traded chipmunk soul for chrome-plated, stadium-sized electronics.

Official cover art · Murakami 2007

Graduation is the third studio album by Kanye West — thirteen songs built to echo across stadiums: vocoder hooks, widescreen synths, and drums that hit like stadium lights switching on.

The visual world was designed with artist Takashi Murakami: a candy-colored cosmos where the Dropout Bear meets floating bear faces, chrome rockets, and fields of grinning bears with very sharp teeth. This site is an unofficial fan tribute to that world — every image here is real album-era artwork and photography.
